title: Goldberg’s streak leads to the world championship
summary: Goldberg’s short, dominant victories turn a newcomer into WCW’s strongest championship threat. The streak grows from television curiosity to a challenge against Hollywood Hogan.

chapters.title: Goldberg wins his Nitro debut
chapters.context: The television debut begins the on-screen undefeated-rise narrative. Advertised streak totals are promotional counts, not an audited match ledger.

chapters.title: Goldberg beats Raven and the Flock
chapters.result: Goldberg defeats Raven for the United States championship.
chapters.context: Overcoming the Flock gives his winning run its first major championship.

chapters.title: Goldberg defeats Hogan in Atlanta
chapters.result: Goldberg beats Hall, then Hogan to become WCW World champion.
chapters.context: Two victories in one night take the rising star past the nWo’s defenses and into WCW’s leading role.
